$description: nc-ui design tokens. The ONE place a colour, font or size is defined. Tier 1 (base) holds raw values; tier 2 (semantic) names a generic role and points at a base value with {group.name}; tier 3 (component) holds roles that belong to one domain (synth, meaning, situation, rhythm) and points at a base value or a semantic role ({semantic.name}). Edit this file, run `node scripts/build-tokens.mjs`, and every consumer picks up the change.

ink-label.note: dark label on a Surprise fill (INK_DARK). ASTRID's surprise.ts used a green-tinted near-black; nc-ui 0.2.0 greys it to ink (no green). Surprise hues and saturations still match ASTRID; a few lightness nudges differ because the ink is a touch lighter

accent.note: the one accent, Prussian blue (ASTRID --nc-acc; it replaced the old green accent). Every accent tint derives from it

astrid-orange.note: ASTRID's identity colour (Peter, 2026-10-29): the instrument name in its title

petra-blue.note: PETRA's identity colour (Peter, 2026-10-29): the instrument name in its title

olive-green.note: OLIVE's identity colour (Peter, 2026-10-29): the instrument name in its title. The one green the kit allows (lint-ui IDENTITY_COLOURS); never for state, controls or fills

hacks-grey.note: the console strips' Hacks label (Peter, 2026-10-30: mixed case, lighter grey). 3.2:1 on module-bg-stack-1: below text-sub's 4.5:1 by request; hover and pressed stay full contrast

lucy-purple.note: LUCY's identity colour (Peter, 2026-10-30: bright purple): the instrument name in its title. 4.8:1 on paper-bright

nyx-amber.note: NYX's identity colour (Peter, 2026-10-30): the instrument name in its title (display size; amber is light, so title text only)

paper-bright.note: a touch brighter than the page (#F5F5F5): the band behind each instrument's title area (Peter, 2026-10-29)

accent-pad.note: filled step / pad: the accent's hue (205°), lighter (HSL 205 70% 34%), so a filled pad stands apart from the ink (accented) pad at 2.35:1 while paper text on it keeps 6.07:1. Pads and step cells only; the accent stays #003153 everywhere else

accent-velocity-min.note: the quietest step (velocity 5%): the accent's OKLCH hue (245.9°) and chroma (0.078), OKLab L 0.54 (the accent is 0.30). Paper on it 4.61:1, it on paper 4.61:1, on the selected-row tint 3.67:1, on the darkest module background (module-bg-stack-4) 3.26:1. Steps and pads only; velocityFill (src/color.js) runs the ramp from here to the accent

sub-0.note: secondary text on paper, modules 01-04 and the selected-row tint (4.5:1 on every shade and the tint)

amber-stale.note: stale status text. Near-duplicate of amber.

plum.note: Meaning: movement (nc-ui 0.2.0: replaces the old olive, which was green)

filter-accent.note: high-pass curve: the accent at 80% over paper (derived; it replaced the old green filter colour)

text.role: primary text, slider thumb, black keys

text-sub.role: secondary text: labels, readout units, idle icons

divider.role: hairlines, slider track, empty slot outline

accent-tint.role: selected row: the accent over the page, light enough for ink text (derived)

accent-soft.role: soft accent fill: a queued slot on the beat (derived)

accent-faint.role: faint accent line: a queued slot's outline and underline between beats (derived)

module-bg-adjacent-1.role: 1st module in the row (01). Adjacent modules step -5 per channel.

module-bg-stack-1.role: a panel stacked inside a module (Hacks 05): one step past the darkest adjacent module

module-slim-column.role: width of a hidden module's column on desktop (hidden-sections.ts SLIM_COLUMN)

section-gap.role: space above a following input section

section-rule-gap.role: space under the rule between input sections

readout-size.role: value readout next to a control

playhead.role: the step that is playing: its ring colour, shared by Rhythm and Bass (Bass's method: an accent outline on the playing pad)

playhead-offset.role: gap between the playing step and its ring, so the ring stays apart from a filled or accented step

slot-span.role: pattern slot width when five share a phone row

slot-block.role: pattern slot height when five share a phone row

beat-gap.role: gap between beat groups in a step row, wider than slot-gap so a bar reads as 4 beats

row-inset.role: how far a selected row's tint reaches past its controls, into the module padding

marker-width.role: the selected row's left marker, thick enough to read at a glance

slot-dot.role: dot under a slot holding an arp

sparkle-size.role: Surprise button box (same as a slot)

label-on-fill-dark.role: label on a bright fill when it beats white

label-on-fill-light.role: label on a bright fill when it beats dark

motion-fade.role: fade, such as a module reveal (duration; pair with motion-fade-easing, as ASTRID does)

motion-fade-out.role: fade out, the slower afterglow when something switches off (duration)

motion-slide.role: slide in, such as a panel opening (duration)

motion-thumb.role: slider thumb size and colour easing on hover/press while a hand drags it; never while the slider is [data-modulated]

motion-meter-rise.role: meter ballistics: rises at once. Exempt from the 100-250 ms window

motion-meter-fall.role: meter ballistics: falls back over about 200 ms. Exempt from the 100-250 ms window

motion-meter-hold.role: meter ballistics: how long the peak-hold line stays before it falls. Exempt from the 100-250 ms window

meter-fill.role: level meter RMS fill: the lighter Prussian blue the controls you play with use; one hue, no traffic-light colours

meter-peak.role: level meter peak fill, above the RMS: accent-pad at 40% (derived)

meter-clip.role: a meter's clip light while lit (latched until clicked): the danger red

meter-track.role: a meter's unlit track and an unlit clip light

meter-width.role: one meter channel's width (a stereo meter is two, control-gap apart)

clip-size.role: height of a meter's clip light

fader-height.role: a console fader's travel and its meter's height (Peter, 2026-10-30: the Mix 15% shorter; no spacing step equals 148)

fader-cap-width.role: a console fader cap's width: a flat rectangle, not the round slider thumb

fader-cap-line.role: the line across a console fader cap's centre

fader-cap-master.role: the master fader's cap: Prussian blue, so the master reads apart from the channels (Peter, 2026-10-30)

strip-bg.role: a console channel strip's background, full height: light grey, alternating with strip-alt-bg (Peter, 2026-10-30)

strip-alt-bg.role: every other console channel strip's background: the darker grey of the light / dark alternation (Peter, 2026-10-30)

strip-hacks-text.role: a console strip's Hacks (Inserts) label and outline at rest: lighter than text-sub (Peter, 2026-10-30; the outline darker than the divider)

fader-track.role: a console fader's slot: ink at 25% (derived)

strip-width.role: one mixer channel strip: the console's hero (no spacing step equals 88)

strip-width-master.role: the master strip: wider, with a stereo meter (no spacing step equals 112)

fx-card-width.role: an FX card in a console row: a fixed width, so the strips take the room (no spacing step equals 232)

strip-fold-width.role: a minimized console channel strip: M and S stacked, the name read bottom to top beside a thin meter (Peter, 2026-10-31)

eq-graph-height.role: the EQ graph's plot in an FX card (no spacing step equals 168)

eq-graph-height-max.role: the EQ graph's plot in a maximized FX card (no spacing step equals 248)

eq-node-size.role: an EQ graph band node's dot (its hit area is target-min while the card is maximized)

eq-graph-bg.role: the EQ graph's plot: a touch brighter than the page in light mode, darker in dark, so it reads as a display

eq-curve.role: the EQ graph's combined response line and its soft fill

eq-fill.role: the EQ graph's soft fill between the curve and 0 dB, and the curve's glow (a lighter blue than the accent line)

eq-grid.role: the EQ graph's frequency and gain grid lines

eq-spectrum.role: the EQ graph's live spectrum behind the curve (a cool grey-blue, under the accent)

eq-band-1.role: EQ graph: the first band (the low shelf), its node and faint curve: OLIVE green (Peter, 2026-11-01)

eq-band-2.role: EQ graph: the second band (the mid bell), its node and faint curve

eq-band-3.role: EQ graph: the third band (the high shelf), its node and faint curve: PETRA blue (Peter, 2026-11-01)

eq-panel-layer.role: stacking layer of a maximized FX card opened over the modules (under page-head-layer)

fx-fold-width.role: a folded FX card in a console row: a narrow column, the width of a hidden module's column (module-slim-column) (Peter, 2026-10-31)

head-margin-compact.role: space under a compact module header (title and index on one slim line: the Studio's Mix)

scale-size.role: faint dB tick labels beside a fader and meter (mono)

focus-width-strong.role: focus outline width on big buttons

target-min.role: minimum hit size on a touch screen: controls are drawn at ASTRID sizes and an invisible pad grows each to this on a coarse pointer (Peter, 2026-10: ASTRID is the north star). Write this token, never the literal

target-min-coarse.role: hit size on a coarse pointer; phones may raise it, never below target-min

rule-strong.role: selected-tab underline, error bar, selected row edge

filter-lowpass.role: low-pass filter curve, shared by synth and rhythm

filter-highpass.role: high-pass filter curve, shared by synth and rhythm

filter-bandpass.role: band-pass filter curve, shared by synth and rhythm

trace-stroke.role: waveform, history line, map route, play head

toast-bg.role: toast background: one dark slab over the page

toast-pad-x.role: toast padding left of the message

toast-gap.role: space between the toast message and its action

toast-offset.role: toast distance from the viewport edge

toast-anchor-gap.role: toast distance below its anchor element (anchored placement)

toast-target.role: toast action hit area, both ways (44 px touch target)

move-size.role: a Move's icon button, both ways (fine pointer; target-min on touch)

move-gap.role: gap between a group's Move buttons

on-danger.role: text on a danger fill (a destructive confirm button)

dialog-scrim.role: the page under an open confirm dialog: ink at 35% (derived)

dialog-width.role: confirm dialog width (never wider than the viewport less dialog-pad each side)

dialog-pad.role: confirm dialog padding, and its least distance from the viewport edge

dialog-gap.role: space between the confirm dialog's title, line and buttons

tab-pad-y.role: padding above and below an underline tab (ASTRID .nc-seg button)

select-pad-end.role: room on a select's right for its arrow (ASTRID .nc-select)

page-head-layer.role: stacking layer of the page header, above the modules, so a menu opened from the header draws over them

page-head-bg.role: the band behind an instrument's title area, from the top of the page down to the header's divider (Peter, 2026-10-29)

instrument-astrid.role: ASTRID's identity colour: its name in the instrument's own page title only (Peter: nowhere else, not the Mix)

instrument-petra.role: PETRA's identity colour: its name in the instrument's own page title only (Peter: nowhere else, not the Mix)

instrument-olive.role: OLIVE's identity colour: its name in the instrument's own page title only (Peter: nowhere else, not the Mix)

instrument-lucy.role: LUCY's identity colour: its name in the instrument's own page title only (Peter: nowhere else, not the Mix)

instrument-nyx.role: NYX's identity colour: its name in the instrument's own page title only (Peter: nowhere else, not the Mix)

page-sub-size.role: the line under the page title (ASTRID text-lg)

page-sub-gap.role: space between the page title and the line under it (ASTRID mt-2)

page-action-gap.role: space between the header's actions and between the title and actions (ASTRID gap-x-6 / gap-6)

page-pad-x.role: page side gutter on a phone (ASTRID px-6)

page-pad-x-md.role: page side gutter from 768 px (ASTRID md:px-12)

page-pad-x-xl.role: page side gutter from 1280 px (ASTRID xl:px-16)

page-pad-y-md.role: page top and bottom padding from 768 px (ASTRID md:py-12)

component.$description: Tier 3: component tokens, one namespace per domain (an app area with its own roles). CSS var: --nc-<domain>-<name>. A module may use generic semantic tokens plus its OWN domain's component tokens, never base tokens and never another domain's. A ref is {group.name} (base) or {semantic.name}. $scope lists the source paths that belong to a domain (ASTRID repo paths; the longest matching scope wins, so meaning/** beats the synth app's src/**).

synth.$description: ASTRID synthesizer modules: the mini keyboard, the VCF filter curves, the curve read-outs.

key-hint-on-dark.role: key letter on a black or held key

key-held-base.role: white key mixed with accent while held in an arp

curve-label-font.role: Hz / ADSR labels under the curves

slim-curve-width.role: tiny curve in a hidden module's read-out (phone)

meaning.$description: The Meaning filter (Meaning dimensions, area meters, timeline).

area-2.role: Meaning filter area MF.2 and the stacked area

highlight.role: current segment in the Meaning timeline

situation.$description: The Situation drawer (bus map, history chart, sources).

rhythm.$description: ASTRID Rhythm (owner: Petra). Step grid, playhead, track mute and solo, and pattern-slot recall geometry. Filter curves are the shared semantic.filter-* roles. Generic slot-*, sparkle-*, trigger-dot, module shading, label/readout type, and slider parts stay semantic. See docs/domains/rhythm.md.

step-cell-on.role: step that is on / selected (accent-pad: the accent's hue, lighter, so on reads apart from accented ink)

step-cell-ink.role: mark drawn on an on step

step-cell-size.role: step-grid cell, the same square as a pattern slot

step-gap.role: gap between step cells, including a full row. Replaces gap-tight (1px) at 2px

playhead.role: the step that is playing (the shared semantic.playhead ring)

velocity-min.role: fill of an on step at the lowest velocity (5%), the light end of velocityFill's ramp

velocity-max.role: fill of an on step at full velocity (100%), the dark end of velocityFill's ramp (#003153)

accent-mark.role: accent mark: a paper bar inside the bottom of an accented step or pad (shade means velocity, so accent is a mark, not a fill)

accent-mark-size.role: height of the accent mark (an inset box-shadow, no layout)

bar-accent.role: downbeat / bar mark on the grid

lane-1.role: lane colour 1, the ink palette colour

lane-2.role: lane colour 2, the accent palette colour

lane-3.role: lane colour 3, the amber palette colour

lane-4.role: lane colour 4, the secondary-text palette colour

sparkle-gap.role: space around the surprise button in a slot row

morph-min.role: morph slider min width, so the row stays one line at 360

morph-readout.role: morph time readout width (no spacing step equals 34)

brand-size.role: instrument name in the page header (PETRA / RHYTHM / 01, as ASTRID / SYNTH / 01)

brand-sub-gap.role: space between the instrument name and the line under it

runtime.$description: Set at runtime by code (see src/color.js). The defaults are the plain, uncoloured look.

surprise-fill.role: slot fill picked by the last Surprise

surprise-ink.role: digit on surprise-fill (dark or white by WCAG 4.5:1)

surprise-on.role: active slot: a deep shade of surprise-fill

velocity-fill.role: fill of an on step or pad at its velocity, set per cell from velocityFill (src/color.js). The default is the plain on fill (step-cell-on) for a cell with no velocity

surprise-lightness.role: Surprise fill lightness range (before the readability nudge)

surprise-min-hue-gap.role: degrees from the previous Surprise hue

surprise-on-max-saturation.role: saturation cap of the active-slot shade

velocity-range.role: velocityFill's input range: the quietest and loudest step velocity (lightest and darkest fill); values outside are clamped

toast-duration.role: ms a toast stays before it fades out (motion-fade-out); any next edit closes it sooner

dark.$description: Dark theme. Each entry replaces the light value of the same token; anything not listed keeps its light value, and every token that refers to a replaced one follows it. The build emits these under :root[data-nc-theme="dark"] and under @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-nc-theme="light"]) }, and as themes.dark in the JS tokens (for canvas). Instrument identity colours keep their light values unless a use fails contrast (LUCY).

paper.note: page ground: a calm warm-neutral dark, not black

ink-label.note: the dark label on a Surprise fill stays dark in both themes (fills are bright)

ivory.note: white keys, dimmed so the keybed does not glare

surf.note: raised surface: hover, filled slot (lighter than paper, as light mode is darker)

accent.note: the accent's dark twin (Prussian blue's hue, lighter): 6.5:1 on paper, paper text on it 6.5:1, 5.2:1 on module-bg-adjacent-4

lucy-purple.note: LUCY's purple, lighter on dark so the title clears 4.5:1 (5.3:1 on paper-bright; #9B30FF is 3.6:1)

paper-bright.note: the title band: a touch further from the ink than the page, as in light mode

accent-pad.note: filled step / pad: paper marks on it 5.1:1; stands apart from the ink (accented) pad at 2.7:1

accent-velocity-min.note: the quietest step: paper marks on it 4.6:1

shade-1.note: module 01 (light mode steps darker, dark mode steps lighter)

shade-5.note: Hacks panel (05): the far end of the stack ramp, a touch darker than the page

sub-0.note: secondary text on paper, modules 01-04 and the selected-row tint (>= 4.9:1 on all)

div-0.note: hairline on paper and modules 01-04 (1.35:1 on paper, as #DDD is 1.25:1 on #F5F5F5)

red.note: danger: 5.6:1 on paper, paper text on it 5.6:1

toast-bg.role: dark theme: the toast is a raised slab (hack card 3), not an inverted one

dialog-scrim.role: dark theme: the page under an open dialog is black at 55%

key-black.role: black key: stays dark in the dark theme (the keybed keeps its physical look)

key-hint-on-dark.role: key letter on a black or held key
